threat_event: Customer and college student records exposed through the Education Software support console
threat_source: Cybercriminal group or malicious insider using a support account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 61 support accounts hold standing read access to every tenant on SYS-E1 and SYS-E2; access not tied to tickets or time limits
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-E3 support console; SYS-E1; SYS-E2; college tenant (SYS-H1)
existing_controls: SYS-G1 sign-in with MFA; console logging by tenant
treatment_plan: Ticket-bound, time-limited, customer-approved support access through PAM; remove standing access; share access logs with customers

threat_event: Ransomware spreads from on-premises legacy sites through shared services and exfiltrates data from several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat networks and local admin passwords at 6 legacy campuses; Student Health legacy domain without MFA; nightly loads into the integration hub
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H4; SYS-S2; SYS-G3; integration hub; warehouse
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on all servers; immutable backups
treatment_plan: Segment legacy sites; unique local admin passwords; accelerate legacy retirement; restore tests for clinic file servers; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: A cross-division incident leads to a missed, late, or inconsistent regulatory or contractual notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix never exercised across divisions; discovery date for platform incidents unclear for the college; district contract terms vary; student versus nonstudent clinic records not classified
regulatory_driver: N61-R02 (314.4(j)); SAIG Enrollment Agreement; N62-R03 (164.404-164.410); N51-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05)
existing_controls: Matrix drafted; SOC playbooks tested quarterly
treatment_plan: Complete the matrix with contract terms; cross-division tabletop; intercompany notice clock of 24 hours

threat_event: AI used in consequential student decisions or children's products without adequate governance
threat_source: Process failure; model error or bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group AI standard adopted 2026 after admissions scoring, proctoring flags, and the AI tutor were already live; no bias testing for admissions; no children's privacy review for the tutor
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H3 AI scoring; SYS-H5; SYS-E2 AI tutor; clinic AI tools
regulatory_driver: N61-R03 (312.8); Colo. SB26-189 (effective 2027-01-01); Title VI; Section 504
existing_controls: Group AI Standard; AI council
treatment_plan: Group AI program (P10): bias testing, notices, change gate, children's privacy review

threat_event: Student and patient data used or disclosed across divisions beyond its legal purpose on the group data platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clinic utilization extract carried nonstudent PHI and contract-college student records into the college warehouse; warehouse roles broad; no purpose tags
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G3 data platform; student data warehouse
existing_controls: Extract suspended 2026-08-07; warehouse query logging
treatment_plan: Purge out-of-scope data; breach risk assessment by Student Health; role redesign; purpose tags; data-sharing standard

threat_event: The college cannot oversee or get timely notice from its own sister division as a service provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2021 intercompany agreement has no safeguards, notice, or assessment terms; SOC 2 report not reviewed by the college until 2026-08
existing_controls: Group common controls; platform SOC 2 report
treatment_plan: Revised intercompany agreement; annual service provider assessment by the college

threat_event: Workforce account takeover through phishing or MFA fatigue
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing defeats push MFA; broad SIS roles for admissions staff
existing_controls: Number-matching MFA; phishing simulations; risk-based sign-in
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant authenticators for all remote workforce access by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Critical third-party outage or breach affects several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Concentration in a few vendors (FAMS, clinic EHR, model provider, rostering partners)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H2; SYS-S1; SYS-E2 AI tutor; integration partners
existing_controls: Annual SOC 2 reviews; contract clauses
treatment_plan: Continuous monitoring of tier 1 vendors; exit and fallback plans per vendor

threat_event: Student Health remains outside group controls after the 2024 acquisition
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy identity domain; pre-acquisition standards; inheritance not documented
existing_controls: Integration program 60% complete
treatment_plan: Complete identity migration; re-issue division supplement; document inheritance
owner: Student Health security and compliance lead

threat_event: FSA finds the college's GLBA safeguards deficient in the Title IV compliance audit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Service provider oversight, disposal, and penetration test scope gaps (P03)
existing_controls: Qualified Individual; annual board report; no GLBA finding in FY2025
treatment_plan: Close P03 High and Moderate gaps before the FY2026 audit fieldwork

threat_event: FTC COPPA enforcement against the District Platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Former district data retained past contract end; AI tutor launched without a children's privacy review
existing_controls: Children's information security program; coordinator designated
treatment_plan: Delete data of 212 former districts; children's privacy review gate; annual program evaluation

threat_event: Late or inaccurate SEC disclosure of a material cybersecurity incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality depends on facts from three divisions and many customers
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter includes cyber
treatment_plan: Include the disclosure committee in the cross-division tabletop

threat_event: Privileged insider misuses access to student or patient data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large administrator populations across divisions
existing_controls: PAM with session recording; quarterly certification
treatment_plan: User behavior analytics on privileged sessions

threat_event: Cloud misconfiguration or exposed credential opens a division data store
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many accounts; static integration secrets
existing_controls: Guardrails; posture management
treatment_plan: Workload identity for integrations; guardrail coverage reports each month

threat_event: Exfiltration from shared data stores goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No egress volume alerts on warehouse storage exports
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; query logging
treatment_plan: Per-store egress alerts; quarterly detection tests

threat_event: Payment and refund fraud through student or staff account takeover
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes in student financials; payroll changes
existing_controls: MFA plus out-of-band confirmation for bank changes
treatment_plan: Fraud analytics on bank detail changes across divisions

threat_event: State student data laws and district contract terms diverge from group standards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,300 district contracts with state-specific terms; online students in all 50 states
existing_controls: Contract register
treatment_plan: Contract term register with notice clocks feeding the P08 matrix

threat_event: A Campus Platform regional outage takes down the college and about 900 college customers at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: College integration hub has no standby; end-to-end recovery untested
existing_controls: Warm standby region; failover tests twice a year
treatment_plan: End-to-end failover test with the college; hub standby

threat_event: Personal information kept longer than needed across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Warehouse keeps SIS extracts indefinitely; former district data retained
existing_controls: Retention schedules exist for core systems
treatment_plan: Automated retention on the warehouse and platforms

threat_event: Cyber outage of campus safety systems during an emergency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mass notification and access control depend on campus networks and one vendor
existing_controls: Vendor redundancy; radio fallback
treatment_plan: Annual failover test of mass notification; segment access control servers
owner: College vice president of campus safety
